changes.mobileMainSkillLayout: Main-skill text and skill level use a stable mobile grid with a fixed 58px skill-level column; long names wrap without shifting the level column between cards.
changes.manualFood1: For species other than Mew and Darkrai, food1 is auto-confirmed only when master-data profiles expose exactly one possible first ingredient. Mew/Darkrai remain selectable.
changes.manualPreviewRecovery: Failed manual-completion crops are retained as failed/missing state rather than cached as successful blanks. The UI exposes retry, preserves successful crops, and retries missing crops on reopen.
